_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the edit-style skill. Every color, font, size, position, duration, easing, rule and sound value lives here. Components and scripts read ONLY this file, the transcript and the new video's input. Percentages are fractions (0.5 = 50%). 'ss' = short side of the frame. 'ms' values are converted to frames with the output fps. Measurements come from 3 reference videos (720x1280, 30 fps, 9:16); see EDITING_STYLE_GUIDE.md for evidence and confidence.

personal.label: Personal brand (colors sampled from the two reference videos: electric blue on paper and black)

derivedRoles.accentDeep: darker blue for blue text on light surfaces (keeps WCAG AA)
derivedRoles.paper: sampled stage color of the light sections (#D6E5F1 to #E9EAF0 with texture), flattened
derivedRoles.dim: sampled overlay for big numbers (#333840 at ~90%)
derivedRoles.positive: not present in the references (green for good states)

personalClassic.label: Personal brand, original palette (kept for reference)

derivedRoles.accentDeep: darker shade of accent (not in brand brief)
derivedRoles.negative: no red in brand brief; coral chosen for X/error marks
no red in brand brief; terracotta derived from orangeDeep for X/error marks

personalAurora.label: Personal brand, Nocturne Aurora (previous look, used by the animated story film)

derivedRoles.accent2: violet for the animated aurora and gradient borders (replaces the old single cyan)
derivedRoles.accent3: cyan kept from the original brand as the cool end of the gradient
derivedRoles.accentDeep: darker shade of accent for light backings
derivedRoles.textMuted: white mixed toward the violet background
derivedRoles.captionTextDim: white mixed toward the violet background

tech.label: Tech review (reference 6): navy stage, electric blue progress, amber emphasis, glass pills

derivedRoles.accentDeep: darker blue for blue text on light surfaces (keeps WCAG AA)
derivedRoles.paper: sampled stage color of the light sections (#D6E5F1 to #E9EAF0 with texture), flattened
derivedRoles.dim: sampled overlay for big numbers (#333840 at ~90%)
derivedRoles.positive: not present in the references (green for good states)

soft._note: Clean, soft glow look observed in all 3 references (thin outline, blurred glow shadow, medium radii).

aurora._note: Animated look for the personal brand: drifting aurora background, rotating gradient borders, floating cards, pop-on-word captions. Everything that moves is parameterised in 'motion' and 'stage.aurora'.

chunky._note: Tawelti look: thick dark outlines, hard offset shadows, fully rounded chips, generous radii. 4 px outline at 1080 wide = 0.0037 of short side.

ref._note: Structure measured on the two reference videos: thin blue outlines on white window cards, soft glow, small radii, bold grotesque type with an italic serif highlight.

layouts._note: All coordinates are fractions of frame width (x,w) and height (y,h). 'portrait' values are measured on the references (9:16). 'square' and 'landscape' are DERIVED (no reference exists) and flagged in the style guide.

swapVariants._note: Graphic-to-graphic transition variants. ref4/ref5 (second batch of references) show blur dissolves, zoom-blur reveals, slide-ups and a hard flash cut into section title cards. Rotated by transitions.swapRotation.

pacing._note: Digital jump cuts: punch-in scale changes at pauses/sentence ends. Footage is never cut, only reframed. Measured on refs: shot median ~3.7-4.6 s, min ~1.8 s, max ~8 s; 2.1-2.5 cuts per 10 s.

silence._note: Silence-only cuts (owner brief): pauses longer than minPauseMs are shortened to keepGapMs. Words are never cut: every word keeps marginFrames of safety on both sides. Audio crossfades hide the cuts.

usage.graphicSwap: between consecutive visuals in the graphic zone
usage.layoutChange: card/split <-> full-screen head, at a pause

sound._note: References contain no music bed (silence between words reaches digital silence in 2 of 3) and very quiet UI ticks at graphic swaps plus one bright 'ding' at the hook. Sounds are SYNTHESISED by scripts/make-sfx.mjs from the parameters below, never copied from references.

music._note: Neither reference batch contains a detectable music bed (spectrograms show speech + room hum only, ElevenLabs tagged no audio events). The bed below is an ORIGINAL synthesised ambient loop (scripts/make-music.mjs) added as an enhancement requested by the owner. Disable with sound.music.enabled=false or --music off.

library._note: Real CC0 samples (assets/cc0, see THIRD_PARTY.md) replace the synthesised fallback of the same name when 'file' exists. gainDb is relative to the voice. tailMs plays only the end of a long riser.

punctuation._note: Recogniser clean-up: wide/CJK marks become ASCII, and Arabic marks that follow a Latin-script word become the Latin mark (English spoken inside Arabic speech).

story._note: Animated short story (scripts/story.mjs). Everything the film needs besides drawing coordinates (art.tsx): colors are palette roles, times come from cues = words found in the transcript, text is story copy. No em dashes anywhere.
script: It's 2 AM. Sami has six hours of raw footage and a deadline.
Cut the silence, add captions, find the music, fix the timing.
So Sami opens a terminal and types one sentence: edit my video.
It trims every pause. It writes every caption, word by word. It adds motion graphics, sound effects and soft music.
Minutes later, the video is done.
Claude can now edit your videos for you.
You bring the story. It does the cutting.

texts.endLine1: Claude can now edit your videos.

director._note: Layout, caption and window-card geometry measured on the two reference videos (REPO, DESIGN). Fractions: x,w of frame width; y,h of frame height. 9:16 is the native format; other ratios reuse the same fractions inside a centered 9:16 safe canvas.
